title: Incremental Cohort Rollout Framework and Eval Matrix
creator: Aisha Khan
description: This ticket defines a reproducible, cohort-anchored rollout framework for incremental feature launches and model swaps. Goal: reduce blast radius during canaries and multi-arm experiments while ensuring signal quality for both business and quality metrics. The deliverables are: (1) an eval matrix that maps primary/secondary metrics to gate thresholds and statistical criteria per cohort size; (2) a rollout cadence template (percentage ramps, observation windows, auto-pause triggers); (3) dashboard and alerting contract for SRE/PM/Eng; (4) a short runbook for rollback and mitigation. The framework is designed to be composable with existing traffic partitioning and experiment gating tooling so that product teams can run staged launches with predictable risk profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Eval matrix covers primary (latency P95, error rate, quality Q_score) and secondary (cost per 1k tokens, downstream conversion) metrics
Default gate thresholds documented for small (<1% traffic), medium (1-10%), and large (>10%) cohorts
Automation hooks defined for canary pause/fallback at 2x baseline error or 20% negative quality delta
Dashboards show cohort-trend breakdowns and expose raw histograms for post-hoc checks
Playbook includes explicit escalation ladder and owners for on-call, PM, and Eng
risks_and_mitigations: Signal sparsity for low-volume cohorts — mitigation: require minimum sample size or extend observation window
Regression masking due to upstream routing changes — mitigation: pin routing version for canary cohorts
Metric drift after config changes — mitigation: automate drift detection and require manual review for >10% drift
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (smoke): 0.1% for 2 hours — sanity checks (status, P50 latency)
Phase 1: 1% for 24 hours — check error rate, P95 latency, quality cohort delta
Phase 2: 5% for 48 hours — run full eval matrix, monitor cost per token and conversion metrics
Phase 3: 25% for 72 hours — extended stress and SLO validation
Full ramp: progressive steps to 100% if all gates pass
metrics_definitions: Q_score: blended quality metric combining automated eval (semantic similarity) and human-labeled regression tests
P95_latency: 95th percentile end-to-end request latency from edge to response commit
Error_rate: proportion of requests with non-200 responses or malformed outputs
Cost_per_1k_tokens: tokenized inference cost normalized to 1k output tokens
instrumentation_requirements: Cohort tagging in request headers and tracing spans
Per-cohort KV cache hit rate and batch size histograms
Streaming logs sample sink for failure triage (first 100 failures per hour)
automation_and_fallbacks: Auto-pause rule: pause rollout when error_rate(cohort) >= 2x baseline over a sliding 30m window
Auto-fallback: route cohort to previous model variant if quality delta < -10% for two consecutive windows
Canary-commit policy: require 2 consecutive passing windows before next ramp
